segments.text: Someone built an AI girlfriend on OpenClaw with full backstory.
18-year-old failed K-pop traininee working at SF marketing startup named Claraara. Text I want to see you. She replies, I miss you so much with Gro
imagine generated gym selfie using her reference image. Remembers conversations via open claws memory. does video calls, works across WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, Slack.
